scope: Make low-level MLINE serialization use the final configured reference identity for its MLINESTYLE link.

issue.before: writeMLine used remapObjectHandle directly for styleHandle, bypassing an installed reference resolver.
issue.wireField: Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object; group 2 is redundant and must agree with that object.

behavior: The MLINE style handle uses the configured resolver when present, and treats its result as the final output identity.
Without a resolver, it uses the established source-handle remap fallback.
The existing source/output graph and style-name consistency checks are unchanged.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory MLINE and MLINESTYLE records; no DWG/DXF fixture files.
cases: existing remap route to the emitted MLINESTYLE identity
reference resolver overrides a conflicting remap for the group-340 link

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; MLINESTYLE validation including both ASCII/Binary resolver precedence controls, 0.47 seconds

limitations: Generated low-level identity translation only; target existence, correct target kind, graph closure, physical producer coverage, native linetype/rendering semantics, and strict whole-document output remain separate gates.
next: Continue P4 MLINESTYLE source-role/provider closure and strict output/readback evidence independently.
